{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print("Rows with sentinel value -999 in biomarker_baseline:")
print(trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999].shape[0])

# Check how many of those are in treatment vs control
sentinel_in_arm = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999]['arm'].value_counts()
print("Sentinel values by arm:")
print(sentinel_in_arm)

# Check the distribution of severity across arms
severity_by_arm = pd.crosstab(trial_df['arm'], trial_df['severity'])
print("Severity distribution by arm:")
print(severity_by_arm)

# Check if biomarker_final is affected by sentinel values
print("Biomarker final mean for sentinel vs non-sentinel:")
print(trial_df.groupby(trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999)['biomarker_final'].mean())"}
